page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. Marginal reference marks at the right edge beside two lines. Gathering signature at the bottom left, catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: 1. In reliquis prædicamentis, substantia, inquam, ad aliquid, actione, passione, spectari motus non potest, quemadmodum Aristoteles luculenter explanat: similiter neq; in istis, videlicet quando, situ, habitu, spectatur motus per se dictus: in his septem prædicamentis non spectatur motus nisi per accidens. Relinquitur ergo, quòd tantùm in tribus illis primò nominatis.
2. In illis tribus tantum prædicamentis inuenitur contrarietas, quæ ad productionem motus omnino est necessaria. Igitur tres tantum species motus secundum illa tria prædicamenta enumerari debent.
Quibus nominibus proprie appellantur tres illæ distinctæ species motus?

Motus qui est secundum qualitatem, communi* nomine appellatur Alteratio, ἀλλοίωσις [?]. Nam alterum solemus appellare, quod differt secundùm qualitatem. Vocamus autem hic qualitates, non ut solemus dicere substantiales qualitates, sed potiùs ut sunt quædam passiones, et passibiles qualitates, nimirum ad tertiam speciem qualitatis reducendæ, siquidem in his proprie consideratur alteratio.

page.notes: The marginal marks beside "communi" and "non ex-" are small printed symbols, read as "*" and "2" with doubt; the symbol beside "communi" may be a fleuron. Greek words (ἀλλοίωσις, αὔξησις) are read from a small scan and may contain errors in accents and breathings. The question "Quibus nominibus..." is set as its own line in the text column, not as a heading. The gathering signature "h 3" is partly unclear. Long s is transcribed as plain s throughout.
